activity_summary: At the church door the apprentices had sprigs of sallow in their caps. You took none. Mistress Ansell would not have a procession of them. You had still written nothing.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a sprig and refused a doorstep note.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Called a cap no church, and turned the house toward home.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named the sallow and the east wind.

facets.activity: Saw sallow sprigs in the apprentices' caps

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: Sprigs of sallow. They have put them in for palms.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not taking a sprig.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: A cap is not a church.
